config.activity_retry: maximum_attempts 1 for model, T-I, T-F, T-N and owner, retried in workflow code as a new Activity so that Event History keeps every attempt; policy and approval use the SDK default (initial 1 s, backoff 2.0, max interval 100 s, unlimited attempts)
config.approval: the approval Activity is cancelled (TRY_CANCEL) once the decision Signal arrives, so the server does not retry it
config.t_n_retry: a timed-out or failed T-N asks the owner; did_not_happen sends T-N again
config.t_f_token: workflow.time_ns() of the Workflow Task that schedules the attempt
config.takeover: a timed-out attempt is rescheduled by the workflow and runs on any worker; a worker busy with an attempt holds no activity poll (max_concurrent_activities 1); workflow tasks leave a dead or stopped worker after the sticky or workflow task timeout
